# Kartoon Studios Announces $300 Million SPAC, Kartoon Studios Acquisition Corporation


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_d133742f59b51a4971e1b42ba4197dab/kartoonstudios/news/2026-11-05_Kartoon_Studios_Announces_300_Million_SPAC_1289.pdf)


November 05, 2026


### EF Hutton will be Sole Underwriter


**BEVERLY HILLS, CA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 5, 2026 /** **Kartoon Studios, Inc.** (NYSE American:TOON) ("Kartoon Studios" or the "Company") today announced that Kartoon Studios Acquisition Corp. ("KSAC") has publicly filed a registration statement on Form S-1 (the "Registration Statement") with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). The filing is for a proposed $300 million initial public offering. KSAC is a newly formed special purpose acquisition company, and its initial public offering will be underwritten by E.F. Hutton & Co.


**The Offering: Size:** 30,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, for gross proceeds of $300.0 million. KSAC also expects to provide the underwriters an option to buy up to an additional 15% of the units to cover overallotments, if any.


- **Trust account:** The offering proceeds will be placed in a trust account for the benefit of KSAC's public shareholders, as described in the Registration Statement.
- **Unit structure:** Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one redeemable warrant. Each warrant entitles the holder to buy one Class A ordinary share.
- **Listing:** KSAC intends to list its units on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "KACQ U."
- **Book-runner:** E.F. Hutton & Co. is acting as sole book-running manager.


KSAC intends to pursue business combination targets in **media and entertainment.** KSAC will be led by:


- **Andy Heyward** , Chairman and CEO of Kartoon Studios and KSAC
- **Brian Parisi** , CFO of Kartoon Studios and KSAC
- **Michael Jaffa** , Chief Operating Officer of Kartoon Studios and KSAC


There can be no assurance that the public filing of the Registration Statement will result in any transaction or other action by KSAC. Kartoon Studios does not intend to comment on or provide updates about these matters unless and until it determines that further disclosure is appropriate or required based on the then-current facts and circumstances.


A registration statement, including a prospectus, relating to these securities has been filed with the SEC but has not yet become effective. The prospectus is preliminary and subject to completion. These securities may not be sold, nor may offers to buy be accepted, before the registration statement becomes effective. This press release does not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any security. There shall be no sale of these securities in any state or jurisdiction where such an offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful before registration or qualification under that jurisdiction's securities laws.


When available, copies of the prospectus related to the proposed initial offering by KSAC may be obtained for free by visiting EDGAR on the SEC's website at[www.sec.gov](https://pr.report/t6xb) or by sending a written request to EF Hutton, 745 Fifth Avenue, 34th Floor & PH, New York, NY, 10151, Attention: Syndicate Department, or by emailing a request tosyndicate@efhutton.com or by calling (212) 970-3700.


**About Kartoon Studios**


Kartoon Studios (NYSE American:TOON) is a global, vertically integrated children's and family entertainment company. It turns owned and controlled intellectual property into enduring, multi-platform franchises. The Company develops, produces, distributes, licenses and monetizes content across the full value chain, creating multiple revenue streams and long-term brand value.


For more information, visit[www.kartoonstudios.com](https://pr.report/t6r3) .
